#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

src_docs = Path("example/k8s-website/docs")
vault_base = Path("/tmp/k8s-docs-vault")

# Track all files for index
docs_by_category = defaultdict(list)
all_files = []

# Process all markdown files
for md_file in src_docs.rglob("*.md"):
    rel_path = md_file.relative_to(src_docs)
    
    # Determine category from path
    parts = rel_path.parts
    if len(parts) > 1:
        category = parts[0]  # concepts, tasks, contribute, etc.
    else:
        category = "root"
    
    # Read frontmatter and content
    try:
        content = md_file.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
        
        # Extract title from frontmatter
        title_match = re.search(r'title:\s*([^\n]+)', content)
        title = title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else md_file.stem
        
        # Find all markdown links and convert to wiki-style
        wiki_content = content
        
        # Convert markdown links [text](/path) -> [[path|text]]
        wiki_content = re.sub(
            r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(/([^\)]+)\)',
            lambda m: f'[[{m.group(2).lstrip("/")}|{m.group(1)}]]',
            wiki_content
        )
        
        all_files.append({
            'path': rel_path,
            'title': title,
            'category': category,
            'stem': md_file.stem
        })
        docs_by_category[category].append({
            'title': title,
            'stem': md_file.stem,
            'path': str(rel_path)
        })
        
        # Create vault file with same path structure
        vault_file = vault_base / rel_path
        vault_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        vault_file.write_text(wiki_content, encoding='utf-8')
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing {rel_path}: {e}")

# Create index with category structure
index_content = """# Kubernetes Docs Graph

> Obsidian vault export of k8s-website documentation
> Generated from {count} markdown files across {categories} categories

## Categories

"""

for category in sorted(docs_by_category.keys()):
    files = docs_by_category[category]
    index_content += f"\n### {category.title()}\n\n"
    for doc in sorted(files, key=lambda x: x['title']):
        rel_path = str(doc['path']).replace('.md', '')
        index_content += f"- [[{rel_path}|{doc['title']}]]\n"

index_content = index_content.format(count=len(all_files), categories=len(docs_by_category))

(vault_base / "README.md").write_text(index_content)

print(f"✓ Processed {len(all_files)} files across {len(docs_by_category)} categories")
print(f"✓ Created index with wiki-style links")
EOF
